{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''mission to Yitabo''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yitabo/Legends|Yitabo]] at some point between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. A group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] captured a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Aware of the capture, [[Churhee's Riflemen]] took steps to rescue the slaves. "[[Gunman]]" was sent to do reconnaissance, although he was captured by the Imperials. Despite this set-back, the Riflemen managed to release all the slaves who then took out their anger on their Imperial captors.
